gloss: slow season; off-peak period; slack period

definitions.gloss: slow season; off-peak period; slack period
definitions.explanation: a time of year when business or activity is at its lowest level

examples.japanese: {閑散期|かんさんき}に{旅行|りょこう}すると{安|やす}い。
examples.english: Traveling during the off-season is cheaper.

examples.japanese: {閑散期|かんさんき}は{暇|ひま}すぎて{困|こま}る。
examples.english: The slow season is so quiet it's troublesome.

examples.japanese: {閑散期|かんさんき}を{利用|りよう}して{設備|せつび}のメンテナンスを{行|おこな}う。
examples.english: We use the slow season to do equipment maintenance.

notes:
FORMS:
{閑散|かんさん} (deserted, quiet) + {期|き} (period) → quiet period

SIMILAR WORDS:
{繁忙期|はんぼうき} (busy season, peak period)

RELATED WORDS:
- {閑散|かんさん} (deserted, quiet)
- オフシーズン (off-season)
- {暇|ひま} (free time, not busy)

BUSINESS STRATEGY:
Many businesses use {閑散期|かんさんき} for staff training, renovations, or offering discounts to attract customers. Travel and hospitality industries often have significant price differences between {繁忙期|はんぼうき} and {閑散期|かんさんき}.
